_comment: CurseForge packs: add new server pack links at the top of 'versions'. URL = https://mediafilez.forgecdn.net/files/<fileId / 1000>/<fileId % 1000>/<file name>. Modrinth packs list their versions live, only the slug is needed.
_propsComment: server.properties for a NEW server: defaultProps, then the pack's own props on top. Updates keep the old file. Only the keys install.ps1 allows are used.
